stylesheets: Only what the frame and its pages (the home page, Changelog, About, How it works) use: 11 of autolaunch.sh's 48 stylesheets, cut to the rules those use. Each file is wrapped in @scope (:root[data-product="autolaunch"]) to (.regents-frame): it applies to the pages of Autolaunch's scope of the router, which marks each data-product="autolaunch", and stops at regents.sh's frame; html and :root read :scope, and a keyframes rule sits inside the scope, as Patchbay's do. autolaunch.sh sets no product on its page, so its main button, link, focus and chosen colours are restated per theme from Regent UI 69dbfface, so they win over Regent UI's Autolaunch product colours. Its plain links and focus ring are restated at the weight of regents.sh's own rules, which they meet unscoped.

Its covered-calls section and connector paragraph have an absent state (none while CoveredCalls.Deployment.current/0 answers {:error, _} or Autolaunch.OAuth.enabled?/0 is false). The rail's Docs row and the footer's Developer docs come with it; About's two links to it keep /autolaunch/docs.

REGENT (/autolaunch/regent, RegentLive): RegentFacts.read/0, a 390-line reader of Base mainnet through Autolaunch.Chain.Rpc and DexScreener, MemestockLanes.base/0 and robinhood/0 (214 lines) and the RegentNext components (548 lines), with TokenDisplay, UsdValue, TokenLinks and Loading. Its Learn link comes with it; How it works' About REGENT keeps /autolaunch/regent.
The About and Docs reads as JSON (/api/v1/about and /api/v1/docs, PublicPagesController.document/2 and PublicDocuments.title/1): the public API, which comes with its part.

How it works' share title and description (ShareCard.how_it_works_meta/0's "How Autolaunch works" and its line): this site's root document states the page's own title and description; the share picture and its words are carried.
The lab line (Layouts.lab_notice/1, "Local Base fork · test assets · no mainnet value"), which autolaunch.sh's root layout shows on a test chain: this site's root document serves every page.
The motion lab (/animations): autolaunch.sh shows it only with AUTOLAUNCH_SHOWCASE on (it answers 404 there today), and regents.sh has its own.

The market ticker (MarketTickerLive), the $REGENT menu (RegentFacts.pool/0), search (SearchLive) and the header's agents and account menu with Pair New Agent: each reads what is not here yet; left out whole, not disabled.
The rail with its Launch button: its links are the bar's; the pages it names come with their slices.

Autolaunch's Live.Session (its :shell stage's current_path is Layouts.on_mount(:page)'s; its shell account control, reload_path and :public_human stage are not brought), Prelaunch's on_mount, the Agents on_mount of the header's agents menu, the page shell plug, theme script and theme plug: this site's session (Live.Session.load_human), root document and theme switch (the same regent_theme cookie) serve every page.
shell_panels.ts: the pairing window and the account menu's links, which come with the agents menu.
The agent documents (llms.txt, agents.md, skill.md, openapi.json, sitemap, capabilities.json): one per site, regents.sh's.
The six old-link forwards (OldLinkController).

AutolaunchWeb.Paths (lib/autolaunch_web/paths.ex): every function names an auction's, a token's, a bid's or a market's page, share picture, video or record, or finds one,; every function but auction/1 and token/1 comes with the first page that calls it.

Every action, policy, calculation, aggregate, AshOban trigger, PubSub notifier and code interface of the 31 resources other than the list reads' (their entry under files), and the domains' hosted MCP tools: they come with the pages and jobs that use them. Among them every other read and write of Auction, Token, XConnection, TreasurySecurityReport and Stocks.Stock, and Auction.MarketState.

The Auctions and Tokens pages (/autolaunch/auctions, AuctionsLive, 226 lines, and /autolaunch/tokens, TokensLive, 142 lines, each listing through LiveListings.paged and MarketCard.list_tools) and AutolaunchHelpers' other parts: they come with the next part. RegentsWeb.Autolaunch.HomeMarket.path/3 already writes their addresses.

The tables with no resource here: session_authorities, linked_identities, account_ens_identities, the five oauth_* tables, faucet_grants, near_fundings, shared_accounts_cutover, subject_actions, Oban's tables and the saved-error tables. Their rows stay in autolaunch_app as the migrations made them.

Autolaunch.Accounts and its HumanAccount, SharedProfile, EnsIdentity, SessionAuthority and LinkedIdentity: a person is regents.sh's Regents.Account.Accounts.HumanAccount, and their linked accounts regents.sh's, read through Regents.Account.Accounts.PublicLink.

The resources with no table (AgentAccount, AgentBid, AgentRobinhoodBid, AgentLaunch, AgentFinish, AgentStake and CoveredCalls.Market), and every other module of lib/autolaunch beside the resources, the two embedded types, the deployment readers (Lab, LabRpcUrl, LabAbi, Stocks.Lab, Stocks.LabAbi, Robinhood.Lab, Robinhood.LabAbi, and parts of LabRpc and Chain.Abi) and the fixed launch terms (parts of LaunchChain, LaunchActions, Stocks.LaunchActions and Stocks.FeeSchedule).

platform/lib/autolaunch/chain/rpc.ex (Autolaunch.Chain.Rpc), whole: the chain client. Regents.Chain.Rpc reads Base only and lacks the expected chain id, the single-call decoders, safe blocks, canonical outcomes, log-range halving, deployment_block and exact format_units it has, so it comes with the part that brings the chain client.

lab_rpc.ex's current/1, uint/6, bool/6, address/6, words/7, call_uint/7, call_words/8, ensure_contract/3, outcome/4 and their private helpers, and block_from_logs/1: each calls the chain through Autolaunch.Chain.Rpc or serves what does, and comes with it.

chain/abi.ex's declared!/3, usdc_address/0, regent_address/0, encode_erc20/2 and topic0/1, with the chain-contracts.yaml manifest and the ERC-20 table they read: here they are Regents.Chain.Abi's declared!/3, usdc_address/0, stake_token_address/0, encode_erc20/2 and topic0/1, with the same answers. Its word_address/1 and address_word/1 come with what calls them.

config/runtime.exs's start-time Autolaunch.Lab.load!/1, Stocks.Lab.load!/1 and Robinhood.Lab.load!/1 and the autolaunch_base_chain_id and autolaunch_robinhood_chain_id settings: the path settings stay, Regents.Autolaunch.Supervisor reads the files they name as the site starts (load_deployments!/0), and each chain id comes from its description.
config.exs's robinhood_read_rpc_url (the Robinhood read address): read only by stocks/market_data.ex, which is not brought; it comes with that file.
